::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

This section is adapted from the convexity part of @zhou2024optim,
used under the MIT License
(see the license text in [Linear Algebra](linear-algebra.qmd#sec-subspaces)).
The source states the first-order and second-derivative tests for convexity without proof;
here they are proved from the Taylor theorem of @sec-optimality.
These parts of the source are not part of this section:

- its catalog of convex functions, including $-\log \det$ of a positive definite matrix
- the convexity of a supremum of infinitely many convex functions
- its exercises and figures

:::
